text: A watcher drains on SIGUSR1 (#463). It admits no new agent operation, lets the admitted ones finish their checks, reviews, repairs, recording and publication, and keeps taking quick steps and renewing its lease meanwhile. Then it releases its lease and exits, and a waiting watcher takes over without running a finished build's agent again. SIGTERM, Ctrl-C and cancellation still cancel work, as #422 made them. Until now a restart threw away every running build and its agent's work, so deploys waited for an idle moment that rarely came with three slots busy. On this repository's launchd setup, each watcher now runs its own binary, so one can take the new release while the other drains.
